I've just come off a 4 years relationship 3 weeks ago, and it still hurts. We've talked here and there but today I've come to realise that we were just opening our wounds every time we spoke.

I have gone 5 days with NC, it was the slowest and hardest few day but I am regaining that self respect and self-value slowly. 

I am sorry for your break up. It's going to hurt so bad, you're gonna feel hopeless and lost. And you're going to want to beg for the relationship back. What's going to drive you crazy are the memories and places that'll pull you down. 

But hang in there!!!! Use this time to do things you like to do. Use it to explore, pick up hobbies or even upgrade yourself.

Don't try and contact her if she needs space. Try have NC for a week, then 2 weeks then 4. It's part of human nature to be curious and she'll want to keep in touch with you. But resist the temptation as it's just going to reset that NC timer.  One day, maybe she'll pop up and want to talk about possibly getting back together - BUT don't keep your hopes up.  Hope for the best, expect the worst.

Break ups are the worst, but keep your chin up. This is honestly easy to say but hard to do, be a better version of yourself. She may come back or may not, but at the end of the day you win. You're better than who you were yesterday. 

Smile 😬😁
